passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: Management’s discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations is provided as a supplement to and should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes included elsewhere in this 2025 Form 10-K to enhance the understanding of our results of operations, financial condition and cash flows. Certain amounts in this 2025 Form 10-K may not sum due to rounding. Percentages have been calculated using unrounded amounts. The comparison of 2024 to 2023 results has been omitted from this Form 10-K and is incorporated by reference from our Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024 “Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” filed on February 12, 2025. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY Bristol-Myers Squibb Company is a global biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases. Refer to the Summary of Abbreviated Terms at the end of this 2025 Form 10-K for definitions of capitalized terms used throughout the document. In 2025, we have achieved multiple regulatory approvals across our portfolio, including the: (i) approval of Breyanzi for adults with relapsed or refractory FL and MCL in the EU, (ii) approval of Camzyos for the treatment of symptomatic obstructive HCM in Japan, (iii) approval of Opdivo + Yervoy as a first-line treatment of adult patients with unresectable or advanced HCC in both the U.S. and the EU, (iv) approval of Opdivo + Yervoy for first-line treatment of adults and pediatric patients 12 years and older with unresectable or metastatic MSI-High or dMMR colorectal cancer in the U.S. and Japan, (v) approval of Opdivo as a perioperative regimen for resectable high risk NSCLC in the EU, (vi) approval of Opdivo Qvantig for use across multiple adult solid tumors in the EU, and (vii) approval of Breyanzi for the treatment of adults with relapsed or refractory MZL in the U.S. Additionally, we received label updates from the FDA that have reduced or removed certain patient monitoring requirements associated with the use of Camzyos , Breyanzi and Abecma . We continue to pursue activities to advance and expand our pipeline through our internal research and development efforts as well as through business development activities. In 2025, the Company (i) acquired Orbital Therapeutics, which provided the Company with full rights to OTX-201, a preclinical in vivo CAR T-cell therapy currently in IND-enabling studies for autoimmune disease, (ii) entered into a strategic collaboration with BioNTech to co-develop and co-commercialize BioNTech's investigational bispecific antibody pumitamig (BNT327/BMS986545) across multiple solid tumor types, (iii) acquired a global exclusive license from Philochem for OncoACP3, a radiopharmaceutical therapeutic and diagnostic agent targeting prostate cancer, and (iv) expanded our development and manufacturing capabilities by opening a new radiopharmaceutical facility in Indianapolis, Indiana, which will support RPTs acquired in connection with the RayzeBio acquisition. We operate in a single segment engaged in the discovery, development, licensing, manufacturing, marketing, distribution and sale of innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases. credit_strengths.text: Operating cash flow comfortably covers capital expenditure and shareholder dividends, leaving substantial internal funding for business development and debt reduction. Free cash flow after capex is strong relative to the dividend, so distributions do not absorb the bulk of internally generated cash.

Operating margin sits above the health care sector median, reflecting the branded oncology and immunology franchise and disciplined cost execution. Revenue is broadly stable year over year, supporting the earnings base from which debt service is drawn.

key_risks.text: Gross leverage sits modestly above the sector median on a same-definition basis, and net leverage also exceeds the sector median, so the balance sheet carries more debt than peers despite the improved earnings profile. Deleveraging depends on sustained EBITDA delivery.

The debt note shows meaningful near-term maturities, including notes due in the coming years and a floating-rate tranche priced off SOFR, alongside a commercial paper program. Refinancing concentrates in the next two years and exposes the issuer to rate resets on floating obligations.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is solid in absolute terms but sits below the sector median, and EBITDA coverage likewise trails peers. The issuer services debt comfortably, yet its cushion is thinner than the health care median, leaving less room if operating income softens.

Free cash flow to debt is in line with the sector median and improved year over year, while cash flow to debt is slightly below peers. The current ratio exceeds one but remains below the sector median, and cash balances offset part of the debt load.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is intermediate, with leverage and cash flow both in the middle tier and headroom to the next leverage boundary. Deleveraging from the prior year is pronounced, and the trajectory supports a stable credit narrative absent large debt-funded acquisitions.

Our forward view is that cash generation should continue to fund dividends, pipeline investment and maturities, though margin pressure from patent cycles and business development spending are watch items. Leverage modestly above the sector median keeps the profile from strengthening further.

credit_strengths.text: 經營現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋資本開支及股東股息，為業務發展及減債留下大量內部資金。扣除資本開支後的自由現金流相對於股息而言強勁，因此派息並未吸納大部分內部產生現金。
經營利潤率處於醫療保健行業中位數之上，反映品牌腫瘤及免疫學業務組合以及嚴謹的成本執行。收入按年大致穩定，支撐償債所依賴的盈利基礎。

key_risks.text: 按相同定義基準，總槓桿略高於行業中位數，淨槓桿亦超過行業中位數，因此儘管盈利狀況改善，資產負債表所承載的債務仍多於同業。去槓桿取決於EBITDA能否持續實現。
債務票據顯示存在可觀的短期到期債務，包括未來數年內到期的票據及以SOFR定價的浮息批次，另有商業票據計劃。再融資集中於未來兩年，令發行人面臨浮息債務的利率重設風險。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率以絕對值而言穩健，但低於行業中位數，EBITDA覆蓋率同樣落後同業。發行人償債能力從容，但其緩衝薄於醫療保健行業中位數，若經營收入轉弱，餘裕較少。
自由現金流對債務比率與行業中位數一致，並按年改善，而現金流對債務比率則略低於同業。流動比率高於一，但仍低於行業中位數，現金結餘抵銷部分債務負擔。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為中等，槓桿及現金流均處於中游，距下一個槓桿界限仍有餘裕。相對上一年度的去槓桿幅度顯著，在沒有大型債務融資收購的情況下，該軌跡支撐穩定的信用敘述。
我們的前瞻觀點是，現金產生應繼續為股息、管道投資及到期債務提供資金，惟專利周期帶來的利潤率壓力及業務發展開支屬需關注事項。槓桿略高於行業中位數，令該狀況未能進一步增強。
